load_ext_standard: load a mmcv extension module by name and verify all required functions exist
load_ext_parrots: load mmcv parrots extensions with fallback fake functions for missing ops
check_ops_exist: check if the mmcv compiled C++ extension module is available on this system
get_fake_func: create a stub function that warns and raises an exception for unsupported parrots ops
has_return_value_ops: review the list of parrots ops that return values versus in-place operations
